visual_requirements.description: Bearded gigantic male Indra, vajra thunderbolt-mace, human anatomy and opaque royal clothes.
Lightning splits mountain and beneficial rain pours.
Storm clouds of Svarga above mountains.

depicted_variant: Bearded Vedic Indra directing vajra-born thunder from Svarga.
aura: Thunderbolt visibly splits mountain(c37), beneficial rain(c36), gigantic bearded form(c27).
artistic_choices: Respectful kingly gold crown and opaque woven royal attire, editorial not sourced as specific costume.
Two compositions with no enemies or violence; overwhelming beneficial elemental action.

prompts.A:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Indra, benevolent Hindu Vedic king of gods, revered and awe-inspiring.
ANATOMY: one bearded gigantic divine male, one head two eyes two arms two legs, fully opaque royal saffron cloth and dark gold patterned armor covering torso/legs, plain gold crown, firmly holding large clear vajra thunderbolt-mace [indra-c02,c25,c27].
POWER: natural branching lightning from vajra strikes mountain so rock parts and rain pours beneficially over dry land; no victims [indra-c01,c36,c37].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, documented gigantic king fills frame, small mountain ridges below for scale [indra-c27].
LIGHT & WEATHER: single lightning flash as key light, warm dark storm clouds, intense rain and rocky dust.
SURFACE: rain-wet textured beard, woven cloth, aged gold metal and rough stone.
SETTING: Svarga storm-cloud realm over mountains [indra-c33,c37].
MOOD: sacred protective majesty, resolute and overwhelming, respectful never monstrous or evil.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no writing/glyphs/letters on clothes/crown/weapon/stone, no text/logo/border/watermark, no extra limbs/heads/eyes, no borrowed movie/game/comic designs, no nudity/gore, no aura/neon/ribbons; lightning is real branching discharge.
MOMENT: Indra sweeps vajra diagonally down toward mountain below, forearm huge in close foreground, severe compassionate eyes focused toward viewer, thunder flash hits distant ridge which splits behind lower silhouette.
